## Faster navigation and profile editing

- Switch between application pages and config editors without reloading the entire LuCI document.
- Keep the application frame in place, refresh settings on navigation, and stop polling from the previous page.
- Protect unsaved form changes and preserve browser navigation history.
- Remove repeated profile parsing when locating imported nodes; cache read-only choice lists briefly.
- Load logs and server/routing status after the initial page is displayed.
- Show BPF and TOML file types in the manual config list.
- Keep individual file-node edits and deletions separate from the original profile.

Validation: UI regression suite and navigation tests; live router navigation and VLESS/BPF editor timing checks. Unsaved-form protection is covered by automated tests.

Includes the navigation module in both package build paths.
